scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cocktail/shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@cocktail/shared && npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@cocktail/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=client
